description: This file implements Bluetooth Audio CAP (Capability) Initiator functions, including registration, metadata validation, broadcast source management, and unicast audio procedures such as start, stop, update, and discovery, with support for broadcast and unicast modes.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_register_cb
methods.description: Registers callback functions for CAP initiator events.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_audio_create
methods.description: Creates a broadcast source for Bluetooth audio.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_audio_start
methods.description: Starts broadcasting audio on a given source.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_audio_update
methods.description: Updates metadata for an active broadcast source.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_audio_stop
methods.description: Stops broadcasting on a source.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_audio_delete
methods.description: Deletes a broadcast source.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_get_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a broadcast source.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_get_base
methods.description: Retrieves the base buffer of a broadcast source.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_unicast_discover
methods.description: Discovers unicast groups on a connection.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_unicast_to_broadcast
methods.description: Converts unicast to broadcast source (not implemented).

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_broadcast_to_unicast
methods.description: Converts broadcast to unicast group (not implemented).

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_start
methods.description: Starts unicast audio streams.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_update
methods.description: Updates unicast audio streams metadata.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_stop
methods.description: Stops unicast audio streams.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing unicast audio procedures.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_metadata_updated
methods.description: Callback when metadata is updated for a stream.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_released
methods.description: Callback when a stream is released.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_started
methods.description: Callback when a stream has started.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_enabled
methods.description: Callback when a stream is enabled.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_qos_configured
methods.description: Callback when QoS configuration is complete.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_codec_configured
methods.description: Callback when codec configuration is complete.

methods.name: bt_cap_initiator_discover_complete
methods.description: Callback when unicast discovery completes.
